findings.title: Permanent passive-vault custody requires independent verification and disclosure
findings.description: Permanent accumulation is the recorded product intent. V19 provides no holder/admin withdrawal, approval, execution or recovery path. Design intent does not close external review.
findings.reproduction: Inspect the frozen vault/factory and reward router at c3750b9458156e962393059f78c92e79802bf622. Deposited ERC20/ERC721/ERC1155 assets have no V19 exit; NFT ownership transfer does not unlock them. See audit/internal-v19/INTERNAL_AUDIT_REPORT.md for verification and self-lock scenarios.
findings.remediation: Preserve the recorded passive-vault decision; publish holder disclosures and obtain the independent verification evidence specified in audit/internal-v19/INTERNAL_AUDIT_REPORT.md. Do not use ACCEPTED_RISK or CLOSED_VERIFIED without policy-compliant evidence.
findings.abi_storage_semantic_impact: NONE: documentation and tracking only; frozen V19 remains unchanged.
